We provide a dataset for the gait analysis which contains extensive ground truths from gait events at the sample index level to gait parameters for normal and pathological walking patterns. We also provide a baseline model to predict the gait parameters from IMU recordings. Please refer to https://github.com/Zhang-Wenwen/GaitMotion for more details.
